verification_policy: Direct research with cross-source acquisition verification. Preserve source conflicts and do not infer Ultimate Finish requirements without explicit evidence.

verification_audit.classification_finding: Current Xenoverse 2 reference material identifies Evil Explosion (Super) as a Ki Blast Super, short-range, chargeable to Stage 3, costing 100 Ki.
verification_audit.acquisition_finding: Piccolo training is the documented acquisition route. Partner Customization later allows the skill for Adult Gohan and Majin Buu (Gohan Absorbed).
verification_audit.ultimate_finish_policy: No Ultimate Finish requirement is asserted. The available evidence establishes instructor training rather than a PQ reward condition, but does not independently provide a negative-UF statement, so the field remains null.
verification_audit.damage_policy: Exact damage values are not promoted as canonical because version stability is not established.

records.name: Evil Explosion
records.character_source: Piccolo, Gohan (Adult), and Majin Buu (Gohan Absorbed) customizable partners
records.skill_description: A short-range Ki Blast Super that can be charged up to Stage 3 before firing a powerful blast.
records.mechanics_notes: Current Xenoverse 2 reference material classifies the move as a chargeable blast with a short-range hitbox and 100 Ki cost. Full charge produces a large stamina-damage effect on block. When used with a Super Saiyan Awoken Skill, the fully charged version can teleport the user to the opponent before firing. The skill also has later Partner Customization availability for Adult Gohan and Majin Buu (Gohan Absorbed).
records.combo_notes: The uncharged version can be used from teleport-oriented combos. Full charge generally requires hard knockdown or a stamina break to connect reliably.
